NVIDIA 
Earnings Summary 
NVIDIA announced Q4 2026 earnings on February 25, 2026, reporting an EPS of $1.62 , which beat the consensus estimate of $1.54 by $0.08 . Quarterly revenue rose 73.2% year-over-year to $68.13 billion , above analysts' expectations of $65.56 billion . With a trailing EPS of $4.90 and a P/E Ratio of 43.90 , NVIDIA's earnings are expected to grow 35.09% next year, from $7.78 to $10.51 per share.

NVIDIA Earnings - Frequently Asked Questions 
When is NVIDIA's earnings date? 
NVIDIA has not confirmed its next earnings publication date, but the company's estimated earnings date is Wednesday, May 20th, 2026 based off last year's report dates. Learn more on NVDA's earnings history. 
What guidance has NVIDIA issued on next quarter's earnings? 
NVIDIA updated its first quarter 2027 earnings guidance on Wednesday, February, 25th. The company issued revenue guidance of $76.4 billion-$79.6 billion, compared to the consensus revenue estimate of $66.0 billion. 
Did NVIDIA beat their earnings estimates last quarter? 
In the previous quarter, NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) reported $1.62 earnings per share (EPS) to beat the analysts' consensus estimate of $1.54 by $0.08. Learn more on analysts' earnings estimate vs. NVDA's actual earnings. 
How can I listen to NVIDIA's earnings conference call? 
The conference call for NVIDIA's latest earnings report can be listened to online. Listen to Conference Call 
How can I read NVIDIA's conference call transcript? 
The conference call transcript for NVIDIA's latest earnings report can be read online. Read Transcript 
How can I view NVIDIA's earnings report? 
NVIDIA's earnings report can be found in their filing with the SEC. View SEC filing 
How much revenue does NVIDIA generate each year? 
NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) has a recorded annual revenue of $215.94 billion. 
How much profit does NVIDIA generate each year? 
NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) has a recorded net income of $120.07 billion. NVDA has generated $4.90 earnings per share over the last four quarters. 
What is NVIDIA's price-to-earnings ratio? 
NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) has a trailing price-to-earnings ratio of 43.90 and a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 27.65. The price/earnings-to-growth ratio is 0.71. 
What is NVIDIA's EPS forecast for next year? 
NVIDIA's earnings are expected to grow from $7.78 per share to $10.51 per share in the next year, which is a 35.09% increase.
